outcomes.reason: ["First end of the Board of Inquiry not established. The held order (31 FR 16301; Board created under section 206 of the Labor-Management Relations Act, 1947, to report on or before December 20, 1966, then to continue in existence) states a report deadline and no end, and a report date is a deadline, not an end. No held source shows when the Board reported, when the Union Carbide Stellite Division (Kokomo) dispute was settled or the injunction proceedings ended, or when the Board was discharged. EO 12553 (1986-02-25, 51 FR 7237) lists this order and is only the formal disposition. Missing source: the Board of Inquiry's report or discharge record for the December 1966 Union Carbide dispute (for example the Board's report, a notice of settlement or of discharge under LMRA sections 206-210 from the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service, NLRB or Department of Justice). Also the dossier clause inventory (16 clauses) covers neighbouring Federal Register documents on the same pages and must be replaced by one whole-order span (held text characters 544-2160) when the ending is sourced."]

["First end not established. The order extends diplomatic privileges and immunities to the Liaison Office of the People's Republic of China and its notified members, effective as of April 20, 1973, under Public Law 93-22 (87 Stat. 24); it has no end in its own text. No held source shows when the Liaison Office ceased to exist or the privileges ceased to apply, and Public Law 93-22 itself is not held. EO 12553 (1986-02-25, 51 FR 7237) lists the order and is only the formal disposition. Missing sources: the text of Public Law 93-22 and an official record of the end of the Liaison Office (for example a Department of State record of the closing of the Liaison Office or of the establishment of the embassy, or a presidential statement)."]

["First end not established. The order creates the Collective Bargaining Committee in Construction (April 1, 1975) with no own-terms end. Section 14(a)(2) of the Federal Advisory Committee Act (held: jobs/selden-statutes/output/texts/STATUTE-86-Pg770.txt) terminates an advisory committee established after the Act two years after establishment (by 1977-04-01) unless renewed, and EO 11948 (held, effective December 31, 1976) does not mention this Committee; EO 12110 (December 28, 1978, effective December 31, 1978) Sec. 1-103(b) revokes the order as establishing a committee that has terminated or whose work is completed, with no date. No held source shows whether the Committee was renewed or when it terminated or finished its work, so the first end is only bounded (not later than 1978-12-31) and the bound is not an end. Missing sources: the Committee's charter, renewal or termination record, or the Committee Management Secretariat / General Services Administration annual report on Federal advisory committees for 1976-1978, or a Department of Labor notice of its last meeting or dissolution."]

["First end of Sec. 1-102 and Sec. 1-103 not citable from the packet. Sec. 1-101 (base production control level) was limited by EO 12209 (April 16, 1980) to the months of January, February and March 1980, but Sec. 1-102 (definition of marginal properties) and Sec. 1-103 (Secretary of Energy regulations) were restated unchanged, and the ending that appears to extinguish them is EO 12287 of January 28, 1981 (46 FR 9909; held at jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12287.txt), which in Sec. 1 exempts all crude oil and refined petroleum products from the price and allocation controls adopted under the Emergency Petroleum Allocation Act of 1973. The packet's citable later events are only EO 12209 and EO 12553, so EO 12287 cannot be cited. Missing source: a source supplement adding the held text of EO 12287 (and, if relied on, the expiry text of the Emergency Petroleum Allocation Act of 1973 on 1981-09-30); EO 12553 (1986-02-25) is only the formal disposition."]
